source: his 2026-10-23 13:10: "we write like 10 missionboard missions for Military Dungeons. Each of those goes to 10 different dungeons leading to 100 unique missions", then 13:32 "yeah go. Also we have droppods, those would be cool"
_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 1 OF ~10: PINNED DOWN. Clear the reinforcements (they come down in pods outside), take the
occupiers' leader inside, then reach the wounded surveyor they had pinned.
WRITTEN TO THE DELVE MARKER SET, NOT TO WHAT HIS SITES CARRY TODAY (his, 2026-10-23 13:35: "don't limit ourselves by
what's there already in my mod, we can add the markers needed later"). Measured that day: the military keyword is
on his 50 Takeover sites, which carry boss, wounded, map marker and travel ring, but no outside entrance, so the lint
pool for this is EMPTY until the entrance marker is added there. The five vanilla military dungeons carry a different
theme keyword (Eliza's part 32), so they are not in reach either; whether one recipe can ask for both is hers.
Pods land at the OUTSIDE ENTRANCE because a pod needs sky, and every delve has an outside.
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed (the pods, the leader, the surveyor).
Pay: med on the talk (capped at med).

place._theme: Military sites. The family's marker set: outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded.

prose.name: Relief: Pinned Surveyor on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A survey detail walked into the <Place> thinking it was empty. It wasn't. Two of them got out; one is still in there, wounded.
prose.card: Relief contract. A survey detail is pinned down at the <Place> on <Planet>, with one wounded. Clear the site and reach them. Expect the occupiers to call for more. Payment on contract completion.

beats._at: Outside the way in: open sky for the pods, in any dungeon.
beats.objective: Clear the occupiers' reinforcements at the <Place>
beats.journal: The occupiers called for help the moment they saw me, and it came down in pods. It's dead now. Their leader is still at the <Place>, and so is the wounded surveyor.
say: Was that them? The pods? Their boss is still in there. So am I.

beats.objective: Defeat the occupiers' leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The occupiers' leader at the <Place> is dead. The surveyor they had pinned is still alive.
say: It's gone quiet. Is that you? I'm by the wall. I'd wave, but it hurts.

beats._at: The wounded marker, on all 50: where vanilla puts a hurt person, so she is where the site expects one.
beats.journal: A survey detail walked into the <Place> thinking it was empty. I cleared the reinforcements, took down the leader and got the one they left behind back on her feet.

person.name: Tamsin Ure
hellos: Slowly. I bite when I'm scared.

greeting: You came. I didn't think anyone would take that posting. We were only here to survey the place. They've had me down by this wall since the morning, and my leg's no good.

reply: If you go slowly, and you don't mind the swearing. Get me back to my ship. I'll tell the office you earned every bit of it.
The listing said it was abandoned. Somebody didn't update the listing.
Two of us ran for the ship when it started. They called it in. That's why you're here, so I can't even be angry with them.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 ends the talk and sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'. Every prompt stands on the greeting (talk_check.py). Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency. Voice 'Shelby', british, unused so far; his ear decides.

broadcast: You're close? I can hear your engines. They'll call for more as soon as they see you. Deal with that first, then come and find me.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. The same voice on the radio and in person.
